manarah.title: Manarah Port Management Platform
manarah.subtitle: A comprehensive platform for operating and managing seaports and logistics services.
manarah.desc: Manarah is our flagship SaaS product — a powerful platform designed to streamline port operations, manage vessel activities, track cargo, and optimize logistics workflows. Built with reliability at its core.

vesselManagement.title: Vessel Management
vesselManagement.desc: Track and manage active vessels, register operational tasks, and assign docking positions.

cargoTracking.title: Cargo Tracking
cargoTracking.desc: Monitor cargo in real-time from arrival to departure with automated container logging.

permits.title: Permits & Documentation
permits.desc: Issue port permits, manage documentation, and maintain historical vessel records.

rbac.title: Role-Based Access
rbac.desc: Multi-role system with RBAC for Port Officers, Shipping Agents, Wharf Managers, Traders, and Executive Management.

notifications.title: Notifications & Activity Logs
notifications.desc: Real-time notifications and comprehensive activity logs for full operational visibility.

reporting.title: Reports & Analytics
